scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @educonnect/shared && npm run build --workspace @educonnect/api && npm run build --workspace @educonnect/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @educonnect/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @educonnect/web
